in_hebrew.name: דוגלאס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם דוגלאס מקורו בשפה הגאלית-סקוטית, ומשמעותו 'נושא המים האהוב על אלוהים'. השם מורכב משתי מילים: 'dubh', שמשמעותה 'שחור' או 'מים כהים', ו-'glas', שמשמעותה 'כחול' או 'ירוק'. השם דוגלאס לא מופיע ישירות במקרא, אך הוא קשור למושגים של מים ושל אלוהים.

in_greek.name: Ντούγκλας
in_greek.meaning: ο αγαπητός του Θεού, ο φορέας του νερού
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ντούγκλας προέρχεται από τη γαλατική-σκωτική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'ο αγαπητός του Θεού, ο φορέας του νερού'. Το όνομα αποτελείται από δύο λέξεις: 'dubh', που σημαίνει 'μαύρος' ή 'σκούρο νερό', και 'glas', που σημαίνει 'μπλε' ή 'πράσινο'. Το όνομα Ντούγκλας δεν αναφέρεται άμεσα στη Βίβλο, αλλά συνδέεται με έννοιες του νερού και του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Douglas
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Douglas originem habet in lingua gallica-scotica, et significat 'amabilis Deo, aquae ferre'. Nomen constat ex duabus vocibus: 'dubh', quae significat 'niger' vel 'aqua obscura', et 'glas', quae significat 'caeruleus' vel 'viridis'. Nomen Douglas non invenitur directe in Bibliis, sed coniungitur cum conceptibus aquae et Dei.

historical_references.reference: According to Scottish legend, St. Douglas was a 3rd century Roman martyr who was beheaded along with his mother and brother in Scotland. His relics were later enshrined in a chapel at Dundee, Angus, Scotland. The name Douglas is said to derive from the Gaelic 'dubh ghlas' meaning 'dark stream' and is believed to be related to the Douglas Water where the saint was said to have been martyred.

The name Douglas was also associated with the English noble family of the same name, which originated from the village of Douglas in Dumfriesshire, Scotland. The family traces its origins back to the 11th century and gained prominence during the Scottish Wars of Independence in the late 13th and early 14th centuries. The name Douglas is believed to have derived from the Scottish Gaelic 'dubh ghlas' and the Old English 'dun' meaning 'fortified place', reflecting the family's association with the fortified settlement at Douglas.
